tools.name: about_wuai
tools.description: What Wuai is, what it does, the platforms it runs on, and its links. Call it first when someone asks about Wuai, or for an app that captions or translates the videos they watch (in real time, as they play), or clips, shares or saves them.

tools.name: get_download
tools.description: Where to download Wuai and how to install it, for Windows, Android, Mac or iPhone (all of them when no platform is given).

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: What Wuai does for free, what Wuai Pro adds, its one-time price, the free minutes, refunds and how to buy.

tools.name: how_to
tools.description: Step by step, how to do one thing in Wuai on Windows and Android, with a link to a short video of it.

tools.name: get_languages
tools.description: The spoken languages Wuai turns into captions, and the languages it translates captions into.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: The latest Wuai releases and what changed in each, newest first.

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Answers to common questions about Wuai: privacy, what it costs, the Windows warning, Mac and iPhone, and who to ask for help.
